connector.name: Work Handler
connector.registryDescription: チームの働き方を支援するグループウェア Work Handler の MCP サーバー。組織・メンバーの参照、出退勤の共有、タイムカード、承認フロー等を本人の権限の範囲で操作できる。
connector.summary: Hosted at work-handler.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.work-handler, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer 形式で MCP 用 API キーを指定する（例: Bearer wh_mcp_prod_xxxx）。キーの発行方法は https://work-handler.app/manual/user/mcp.md を参照。
